column2: Because of a cross-default provision, missing one loan payment made every other loan due immediately.
column3: 由於有交叉違約條款，一筆貸款沒還，其他貸款立即全部到期。
column4: trigger a cross-default provision (觸發交叉違約條款)
column5: cross 是交叉：一張骨牌倒，其他借款跟著倒
column7: cross de - fault pro - vi - sion
column8: 交叉違約條款；任一債務違約即全面到期

column2: A pari passu clause ensures unsecured bondholders are paid at the same rank when the issuer fails.
column3: 同等權益條款確保發行人倒閉時，無擔保債券持有人以相同順位受償。
column4: include a pari passu clause (納入同等權益條款)
column5: pari passu 是拉丁文「同步前進」，債主排排站同樣受償
column8: 同等權益條款；無擔保債券平起平坐受償

column2: A subordination agreement placed the founder's loan behind the bank's, so the bank would be repaid first.
column3: 次順位協議把創辦人的貸款排在銀行之後，因此銀行會先獲得清償。
column4: sign a subordination agreement (簽署次順位協議)
column5: sub 在下面：排隊時站後面，錢要等前面的人先領
column7: sub - or - di - na - tion a - gree - ment
column8: 次順位協議；後順位清償的次級債券合約

column2: Holders of senior secured debt can claim the warehouse itself if the borrower stops paying.
column3: 優先有擔保債券的持有人，在借款人停止還款時可以求償那座倉庫。
column4: repay senior secured debt (償還優先有擔保債務)
column5: senior 排第一，secured 有抵押品當靠山，最安心
column8: 優先有擔保債券；擁有特定不動產抵押權

column2: An unsecured junior bond paid a high yield because investors feared they might lose everything if the issuer failed.
column3: 無擔保次級債券支付高殖利率，因為投資人擔心發行人倒閉時會血本無歸。
column4: buy an unsecured junior bond (買進無擔保次級債券)
column5: 沒抵押又排後面，風險像走鋼索，所以利息要給高
column7: un - se - cured jun - ior bond
column8: 無擔保次級債券；風險高，殖利率相應也高

column2: Buyers of the convertible debenture earn interest now and may swap it for shares if the stock climbs.
column3: 可轉換信用債券的買家現在領利息，股價上漲時還能換成股票。
column4: issue a convertible debenture (發行可轉換信用債券)
column5: convert 是轉換：先領利息，股價漲了再變身成股票
column7: con - vert - i - ble de - ben - ture
column8: 可轉換信用債券；兼具債息與股票上漲期權

column2: Warrant attachment sweetened the bond offering, since each buyer also received the right to purchase new shares at a set price.
column3: 附認股權證讓債券發行更有吸引力，因為每位買家還獲得以固定價格認購新股的權利。
column4: offer warrant attachment (提供附認股權證)
column5: warrant 是優惠券，附贈在債券上，可用約定價買新股
column8: 附認股權證；附帶以約定價認購新股的權利

column2: The board approved a stock option grant for senior engineers to keep them motivated and loyal to the firm.
column3: 董事會核准對資深工程師發放認股權，讓他們保持幹勁並對公司忠誠。
column4: approve a stock option grant (核准認股權發放)
column5: option 是選擇權：員工可選擇以舊價買股，公司賺錢他就賺
column8: 認股權發放；激勵高階員工、激發敬業精神

column2: Each restricted stock unit turns into one real share only after the employee completes a year of service.
column3: 每個受限股票單位，要等員工服務滿一年後，才會轉成一股真正的股票。
column4: receive a restricted stock unit (獲得受限股票單位)
column5: restricted 是受限：股票先放保險箱，做滿年限才給鑰匙
column7: re - strict - ed stock u - nit
column8: 受限股票單位（RSU）；按服務年限分批發放

column2: During the four-year vesting period, an employee who resigns forfeits the options not yet earned.
column3: 在四年的歸屬期間，離職的員工會失去尚未取得的選擇權。
column4: a four-year vesting period (四年歸屬期)
column5: vest 像穿上背心：等期滿才算正式取得，中途不能變現
column8: 既得歸屬期；股票選擇權閉鎖、不得變現的期間

column2: Phantom stock gave managers a bonus tied to the share price, though no actual shares changed hands.
column3: 虛擬股票讓經理人的獎金與股價掛鉤，但並未真正轉移任何股份。
column4: grant phantom stock (授予虛擬股票)
column5: phantom 是幻影：看得到股價分紅，卻摸不到真的股票
column8: 虛擬股票；享有股價分紅但不給予真實股權

column2: A performance share vests only if the company reaches its profit target by the end of 2028.
column3: 績效股票只有在公司於二〇二八年底前達成獲利目標時，才會兌現。
column4: award a performance share (頒發績效股票)
column5: performance 是表現：業績達標才發獎，沒做到就落空
column8: 績效股票；達成特定業績目標才予兌現

column2: The departing director received a golden handshake worth two years of salary to leave without a dispute.
column3: 即將離職的主管拿到相當兩年薪水的黃金握手條件，平和離開不起爭議。
column4: offer a golden handshake (提供黃金握手)
column5: 握手道別時手上是金子：高額補償讓人好聚好散
column8: 黃金握手；優退優離的巨額補償金協議

column2: Under its clawback policy, the bank reclaimed bonuses from executives after the earnings were restated.
column3: 依據追回機制，銀行在財報重編後向高階主管追回獎金。
column4: enforce a clawback policy (執行追回機制)
column5: claw 是爪子：獎金發出去了，還能用爪子抓回來
column8: 追回機制；財報重編時追繳高管績效獎金

column2: Board independence improved when outside directors held a majority and could challenge the chief executive.
column3: 當外部董事占多數並能質疑執行長時，董事會獨立性就提升了。
column4: ensure board independence (確保董事會獨立性)
column5: independent 是不依賴：董事不聽老闆的，才敢說真話
column8: 董事會獨立性；獨立董事過半以監督利益

column2: The audit committee, made up entirely of outside directors, reviewed the financial statements before publication.
column3: 完全由外部董事組成的審計委員會，在發布前審查了財務報表。
column4: chair the audit committee (擔任審計委員會主席)
column5: audit 是查帳：一群獨立的人坐一桌，幫公司把帳看緊
column8: 審計委員會；全由獨立董事組成，把關財報

column2: The compensation committee capped the chief executive's bonus after shareholders complained about excessive pay.
column3: 股東抱怨薪酬過高後，薪酬委員會為執行長的獎金設下上限。
column4: the compensation committee approves pay (薪酬委員會核定薪酬)
column5: compensation 是報酬：專門決定誰領多少，不讓老闆自己加薪
column7: com - pen - sa - tion com - mit - tee
column8: 薪酬委員會；核定經理人薪酬、避免自肥

column2: The nominating committee interviewed six candidates before recommending two for the vacant board seats.
column3: 提名委員會面談六位人選後，推薦兩位填補董事會空缺。
column4: the nominating committee selects candidates (提名委員會遴選候選人)
column5: nominate 是提名：像班上選幹部，先推薦誰適合上場
column7: nom - i - nat - ing com - mit - tee
column8: 提名委員會；遴選董事候選人與其專業背景

column2: As lead independent director, she chaired the meeting where outside directors discussed the chairman's performance without him.
column3: 身為首席獨立董事，她主持外部董事會議，在董事長不在場時討論他的表現。
column4: serve as lead independent director (擔任首席獨立董事)
column5: lead 是帶頭：獨立董事小組的班長，替外部股東發聲
column7: lead in - de - pen - dent di - rec - tor
column8: 首席獨立董事；代表外部股東主持會議

column2: A shareholder derivative suit accused former executives of wasting company funds and demanded they repay the firm.
column3: 股東代表訴訟指控前高階主管浪費公司資金，要求他們對公司賠償。
column4: file a shareholder derivative suit (提起股東代表訴訟)
column5: derivative 是衍生：股東代替公司出面告，賠償金歸公司
column7: share - hold - er de - riv - a - tive suit
column8: 股東代表訴訟；股東代公司向前高管求償

column2: Piercing the corporate veil let the court hold the owner personally liable for the shell company's unpaid debts.
column3: 揭開公司面紗，讓法院要求所有人以個人財產清償空殼公司未付的債務。
column4: risk piercing the corporate veil (有被揭開公司面紗的風險)
column5: veil 是面紗：法院把公司面紗掀開，看見背後真正的主人
column7: pierc - ing the cor - po - rate veil
column8: 揭開公司面紗；追究幕後股東的無限清償責任

column2: The business judgment rule protected directors who had studied the facts carefully, even though the acquisition lost money.
column3: 商業判斷法則保護了仔細研究過事實的董事，即使那次收購賠了錢。
column4: invoke the business judgment rule (援引商業判斷法則)
column5: judgment 是判斷：認真盡責做決定，輸了法官也不怪你
column7: bus - i - ness judg - ment rule
column8: 商業判斷法則；善盡注意義務者免除賠償

column2: The court voided the contract as an ultra vires act, since the charter never allowed the firm to buy land.
column3: 法院判定該合約為越權行為而無效，因為公司章程從未允許公司購買土地。
column4: commit an ultra vires act (做出越權行為)
column5: ultra 是超過、vires 是力量：做事超出被授予的權力範圍
column8: 越權行為；超出公司章程授權的違法合約

column2: The hostile bidder went straight to shareholders with its offer after the board refused to negotiate.
column3: 董事會拒絕談判後，敵意收購方直接向股東提出報價。
column4: fend off a hostile bidder (擊退敵意收購方)
column5: hostile 是不友善：沒敲門就闖進來想買公司的人
column8: 敵意收購方；未經董事會同意發動突襲者

column2: Shares of the target company jumped fifteen percent as several suitors began competing to buy it.
column3: 數家追求者開始競相收購，目標公司的股價大漲百分之十五。
column4: the target company's board (目標公司的董事會)
column5: target 是靶子：成為眾人瞄準、想買下的那家公司
column8: 被收購的目標公司；遭各方角逐爭奪的標的

column2: The struggling publisher turned to a white knight defense and invited a friendly rival to offer a higher price.
column3: 這家陷入困境的出版商採取白武士防禦，邀請一家友善的同業開出更高價格。
column4: mount a white knight defense (採取白武士防禦)
column5: 騎白馬的武士前來救駕，趕走兇惡的敵方
column8: 白武士防禦；尋求友善第三方以高價收購

column2: To fight off the raider, the retailer used a crown jewel defense and sold its most profitable division.
column3: 為了擊退狙擊者，這家零售商採用皇冠明珠防禦，賣掉獲利最高的部門。
column4: use a crown jewel defense (採用皇冠明珠防禦)
column5: 把皇冠上最亮的寶石先賣掉，對方就沒興趣搶皇冠
column8: 皇冠明珠防禦；出售最核心資產以擊退惡意收購

column2: Facing a takeover bid, the smaller firm tried a Pac-Man defense and began buying shares of its attacker.
column3: 面對收購要約，這家較小的公司嘗試小精靈防禦，反過來買進攻擊者的股份。
column4: launch a Pac-Man defense (發動小精靈防禦)
column5: 小精靈吃了大力丸反過來吃鬼：被追的反咬追的
column8: 小精靈防禦；反向收購敵意方股份以制敵

column2: The raider accepted a greenmail payment, selling its shares back to the company at a premium and walking away.
column3: 狙擊手接受綠色勒索支付，以溢價把股份賣回給公司後離去。
column4: make a greenmail payment (支付綠色勒索)
column5: greenmail＝green 鈔票 + blackmail 勒索，付錢請對方別鬧
column8: 綠色勒索支付；溢價購回狙擊手所持股份

column2: Under a standby commitment, the underwriter promised to buy any shares that existing investors left unsold.
column3: 依據備用承諾，承銷商答應買下現有投資人未認購的任何股份。
column4: provide a standby commitment (提供備用承諾)
column5: stand by 是在旁待命：沒人買的股票，由承銷商接手
column8: 備用承諾；承銷商保證吃下未認購的剩餘股

column2: In firm commitment underwriting, the bank bought the entire issue and bore the loss if investors stayed away.
column3: 在包銷中，銀行買下整批發行股，若投資人不捧場，由銀行承擔損失。
column4: choose firm commitment underwriting (選擇包銷)
column5: firm 是堅定：承銷商拍胸脯全包，賣不掉自己扛
column7: firm com - mit - ment un - der - writ - ing
column8: 包銷；承銷商自負滯銷風險、全額買斷

column2: With best efforts underwriting, the bank only tried to sell the shares and owed nothing for any left over.
column3: 在代銷中，銀行只負責盡力銷售，剩下沒賣完的股份概不負責。
column4: prefer best efforts underwriting (偏好代銷)
column5: best efforts 是盡力而為，但不保證賣完
column7: best ef - forts un - der - writ - ing
column8: 代銷；承銷商盡力銷售，不負未售完責任

column2: The greenshoe option let underwriters sell extra shares and buy them back to steady the price after the listing.
column3: 綠鞋選擇權讓承銷商多售股票，並在上市後回補以穩定股價。
column4: exercise the greenshoe option (行使綠鞋選擇權)
column5: 名稱來自最早用此條款的 Green Shoe 公司，專門穩住新股價
column8: 綠鞋選擇權；超額配售權，穩定上市首發價

column2: A six-month lock-up period prevented early investors from dumping their shares right after the IPO.
column3: 為期六個月的閉鎖期，防止早期投資人在首次公開發行後立刻拋售股票。
column4: end of the lock-up period (閉鎖期結束)
column5: lock 是上鎖：股票被鎖進櫃子，期滿才能拿出來賣
column8: IPO 閉鎖期；內部重大股東半年內禁止拋售

column2: Before the offering, executives flew across three continents on a roadshow to pitch investors.
column3: 發行前，高階主管飛越三大洲進行路演，向投資人簡報。
column4: go on a roadshow (進行路演)
column5: road 路 + show 展示：一路巡迴，把公司秀給投資人看
column8: 法人說明巡迴路演；向大戶機構簡報以募資

column2: Through book building, the bank collected bids from funds and set the offer price where demand was strongest.
column3: 透過詢價圈購，銀行向基金收集出價，並把發行價定在需求最強之處。
column4: book building process begins (詢價圈購程序開始)
column5: book 是簿冊：把各家基金想買的數量一筆筆記在簿子上
column8: 詢價圈購；收集機構法人意向以訂立承銷價
